description: gray two-panel leaf with gold lever
summary: Prepared the selected animated source part as one real framed door; source animation is frozen at its closed pose for the common isolated push-door model. Frame, leaf, handles, hinge hardware and edge plates retain visuals and collisions.
modifications: Select only the original named door/skeleton subtree; preserve the original USDZ and all seven packaged image dependencies.
Normalize the selected closed Y-up centimeter pose to Z-up meters at 1.65 uniform scale.
Apply the documented 2% uniform moving-assembly fit because 1% left a measured leaf/hinge interference; preserve all required collisions and partition the modeled frame collider around its opening.
Use the modeled negative-side hinge barrels to infer the right-handed pivot at the opening face; retain the source appearance.
validation_scope: One source review, individual inspection, passing normalization/static, actually viewed front/rear RTX previews and one short isolated RTX 4090 cuda:0 physics run per selected part; no robot/expert qualification or unrelated test matrix.
limitations: Hinge axis and 2% clearance fitting are documented simulation approximations, not recovered manufacturer dimensions.
The source animation is not replayed in the prepared articulation; the closed pose starts already unlatched for pushing.
Robot reachability and the expert 45-degree criterion remain untested in Subphase 5.1.
next_steps: Use the unchanged 5.1 robot/expert protocol only when that subphase starts.
